overview.about: The American Express is a sun-soaked pro-am in the California desert around La Quinta and PGA West, long a celebrity-studded fixture of the Palm Springs area. Multiple easy-scoring courses make it one of the lowest-scoring weeks on the PGA Tour.
overview.nextEvent: The next American Express rotates the opening rounds across desert courses at PGA West and La Quinta before the final round on a single layout. Birdies come in bunches on the resort-style setups.
